## How to support EditorConfig with C# Dev Kit

**EditorConfig (.editorconfig) files** are supported with the [EditorConfig for {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=EditorConfig.EditorConfig), letting you customize formatting options in your C# project.  These files are also used to override the user/workspace settings with the settings you specify in them.
